t: 起义军在农民叛乱中罢免了中国首都长安.
te: Rebels sack the Chinese capital Chang'an during a peasant rebellion.
dz: 起义军在农民叛乱中罢免了中国首都长安.
de: Rebels sack the Chinese capital Chang'an during a peasant rebellion.

t: 起义军将王满斩首,仅是新朝皇帝,后因农民叛乱被罢免.
te: Rebels decapitate Wang Mang, only Emperor of the Xin Dynasty, after his capital was sacked during a peasant rebellion.
dz: 起义军将王满斩首,仅是新朝皇帝,后因农民叛乱被罢免.
de: Rebels decapitate Wang Mang, only Emperor of the Xin Dynasty,  after his capital was sacked during a peasant rebellion.
